about_the_game:
A FREE game where you battle vtubers in epic turn-based combat.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Story

Take a peek into a parallel world, a fascinating ecosystem through the eyes of an overly curious observer. Follow along a journey of self-development, misadventure, and foolhardy ambition.

Traverse through day & night, endure the soak, shock, and scorch of the elements and slowly uncover the nature of the island.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Gameplay 

-Acquire an arsenal of hand-crafted gears and skills to help navigate the island as well as kick butt in battle.

-Take on a variety of vtuber boss fights, each one tougher than the last.

-Follow along a silly narrative that is about as deep or nonsensical as you interpret it to be.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Island

The island ain't an easy place to walk through.

-Acquire vtuber companions, each with their own unique skillset fit for
clearing obstacles, solving puzzles, and aiding in battle.

-Explore various environments

-Solve logical puzzles

-Navigate open-ended obstacles.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Combat 

There's a total of 30 different enemies to face against, 12 of which being powerful vtuber adversaries.

Each boss fight is uniquely stylized & dynamic. It'll take observation, skill, and strategy to overcome the challenges each vtuber brings to the table.

If you're feeling confident, strapping on the submission wristband will let em' know not to hold back.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Features 

  • 12 Vtubers to battle

  • 30 total enemies

  • Original Soundtrack

  • Achievements

  • Support your battle style with Wristbands

  • Dynamic turn-based battle system

  • Acquire Vtuber Companions

  • Subdivided Narrative (With some overlap)

  • Jump into battles directly in Arcade mode

  • Challenge yourself in Hard mode

  • A sprinkle of downsilliness

  • A miniscule amount of tomfoolery

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

More Info 

Rabbithole Island is a solo-project created by Missile.

Rabbithole Island can be described as a collage of inspiration formed from multiple influences.  

What started as a simple thought experiment, quickly becoming a full-fledge experience.
Give this game a go if you're interested. ^-^
